title: Normalized scalar extension of regular sheaf modules and multiplication
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be an essentially small site, with universes chosen so that the sheafification and closed symmetric monoidal structure on $\Sh(\mathcal C,\mathrm{Ab})$ of [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor] are defined. Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a morphism of commutative ring objects, and use the internal module objects and regular modules of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. For a ring sheaf $A$, let $\Gamma(\mathcal C,A)$ denote its compatible families of sections, equivalently maps $\underline{\mathbf Z}\to A$. For $t\in\Gamma(\mathcal C,R)$ write $m_t:R\to R$ for multiplication by the restricted section $t_U$ on every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$.

For the extension of scalars $\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi$ constructed by the balancing coequalizer of [def-sfb-modobj-extension], there is a canonical $S$-linear isomorphism
$$q:\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi(R)=S\otimes_RR\xrightarrow{\sim}S.$$
It is characterized on the local tensor generators by
$$q(b\otimes a)=b\varphi(a),\qquad q^{-1}(b)=b\otimes1.$$
These equations are equations of sheaf morphisms after the canonical map from the presheaf tensor to the sheaf tensor and then the balancing coequalizer; they do not identify arbitrary sections of the tensor sheaf with pure tensors. If $\iota:R\to S\otimes_RR$ is the underlying abelian-sheaf map given by $a\mapsto1\otimes a$, then $q\circ\iota=\varphi$. For every $t\in\Gamma(\mathcal C,R)$, multiplication $m_t$ is an $R$-linear sheaf endomorphism and
$$q\circ\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi(m_t)=m_{\varphi(t)}\circ q.$$
The maps and these equalities use the indicated sheafified tensor and coequalizer, including the regular-module actions, for arbitrary $\varphi$ (no invertibility or flatness assumption).
